descriptionChirho: To become dry, to dry up, or to wither, said of water, plants, land, or bones (Qal and Nifal stems).
To make something dry, to dry up or parch something, used of God or agents drying rivers, seas, or vegetation (Hifil and Piel stems).
To be ashamed or put to shame, to suffer disgrace or humiliation (Hifil stem with shame meaning, distinct from the drying sense).
